scope: Rejected stop-handle board controls with incorrectly selected XSPICE initialization; not observer or rollback qualification.
finding: The producer copied the baseline runtime receipt but built its subprocess environment from ambient os.environ without SPICE_SCRIPTS. The claimed initialization was not selected; candidate logs lack the baseline HISTORY_INIT and DAC_ANCHORED startup diagnostics.
correction: Identify the runtime from its explicit executable and spinit, compare the complete fingerprint, pass and record SPICE_SCRIPTS, and require matching startup diagnostics. Repeat all candidate controls in a fresh directory.
retainedEvidence: Original producer/reviewer, immutable run receipts, startup excerpts and exact first mismatch. Complete original compressed captures remain at the local path; this report does not claim full replay from its excerpts.
